events.description: Shows a retry button in the error state.
events.name: onRetry

events.description: Shows a refresh button in the header that runs it; its icon spins while `isRefreshing` (still under reduced motion).
events.name: onRefresh

events.description: Called with the order picked in the sort menu.
events.name: onSortChange

events.description: Called when the compare switch is turned on or off.
events.name: onCompareChange

props.description: The widget's title; it also names the region.
props.name: title

props.description: A muted line under the title, such as the range shown.
props.name: description

props.description: Controls at the header's end: a range picker, a menu, a link to the full report.
props.name: actions

props.description: A row under the body: a "View all" link, a last-updated note.
props.name: footer

props.description: What the body shows; `ready` by default.
props.name: state

props.description: The empty note; "No data for this range yet" by default.
props.name: emptyText

props.description: The error note; "This widget could not load" by default.
props.name: errorText

props.description: True while fresh data loads behind the current body: a quiet spinner in the header.
props.name: isRefreshing

props.description: The columns it spans in a 12-column dashboard grid (web); `medium` by default. Native fills the width.
props.name: size

props.description: When the data was fetched: the header reads "Updated 2 min ago" in the locale and keeps it current.
props.name: updatedAt

props.description: A row under the header for the body's own controls: a range or period picker, a filter.
props.name: controls

props.description: The overflow menu's entries, in this order; no menu when left out. `csv` and `table` read `data`.
props.name: menu

props.description: The numbers behind the body: the "View as table" view, the accessible alternative, and the CSV download.
props.name: data

props.description: The downloads' file name without its extension; the title by default.
props.name: fileName

props.description: The order the body's categories are in; with `onSortChange`, the header shows a sort menu.
props.name: sort

props.description: Whether the previous period is drawn beside this one; with `onCompareChange`, the controls row shows a switch.
props.name: isComparing
